name: Grade 10 Geography: Factors Influencing Climate
subject: Geography
learningObjectives: By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to state the factors that influence climate
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be able to explain how altitude affects temperature
learningActivities: Discussion: why is it colder on Mount Kenya than in Nairobi?
Explanation: teacher explains factors using diagrams
Group work: learners list and explain factors influencing climate
Application: learners relate factors to Kenya's climate
keyPoints: Climate is the average weather conditions of a place over a long period
Factors influencing climate include latitude, altitude, distance from the sea, and ocean currents
Temperature decreases with increase in altitude
commonMisconceptions: Thinking latitude and altitude have the same effect on temperature
lessonEvaluation: Learners state and explain factors influencing climate. Teacher assesses through group presentations.
teacherReflection: Good participation. Reinforce the difference between weather and climate.
